text:
maria.t: Compliance asked for 13 months retention for auth/admin logs; our Splunk export only retains 90d. Can we propose options? Also they want read-only access for auditors — what's the minimal RBAC change? cc @raj.s @alex.k

raj.s: Two separate pieces here: storage vs access. For storage we can either extend Splunk retention (expensive + license implications) or forward raw events to an S3 archival bucket with a 13mo lifecycle. We already have an export flow for backups so piggybacking seems simplest.

alex.k: +1 on S3 archive. Also think about KMS: compliance prefers customer-managed CMK (per-division or per-domain) instead of a shared key. That affects the key policy (we need to allow the splunk-ingest-role kms:Encrypt and auditors kms:Decrypt).

maria.t: Do we have a concrete S3 lifecycle snippet we can show them?

raj.s: Here's a minimal example we can paste to compliance: 

```json
{
  "Rules": [
    {
      "ID": "13mo-archive",
      "Prefix": "",
      "Status": "Enabled",
      "Transitions": [
        { "Days": 30, "StorageClass": "STANDARD_IA" }
      ],
      "Expiration": { "Days": 395 }
    }
  ]
}
```

alex.k: Use 395 days ~ 13 months. Also call out retention vs deletion semantics in the proposal. S3 Object Lock is an option for tamper-proof retention if compliance requires WORM, but it's heavier and will block restores. For KMS: ingestion only needs Encrypt. Auditors (or our log-reader role) need Decrypt. So key policy must grant Encrypt to the splunk role and Decrypt to the log-reader principal.

maria.t: For RBAC I'd like to keep it scoped and low-friction: create a "log-reader" IAM role that maps to a SCIM group for auditors (read-only). Role policy: s3:GetObject on s3://audit-logs/* and kms:Decrypt on the CMK ARN. No s3:ListBucket or wildcard perms. Thoughts?

raj.s: Sounds good. One caveat: Splunk HEC -> S3 pipeline uses the splunk-ingest-role; we'll need to update that role's trust/doc to allow kms:Encrypt with the new CMK. Also add CloudTrail + EventBridge rule to alert on ListObject or GetObject for the audit bucket so we can detect abnormal access.

eng-ops-bot: deploy job queued: create-audit-bucket-1790123700 (queued)

maria.t: Proposed action items:
1) Alex to draft CMK key policy + S3 lifecycle JSON for compliance by EOD.
2) Raj to draft IAM role policy & RBAC mapping and an alerting rule for GetObject events.
3) I'll schedule a compliance review next Wed (invite sent). :thumbsup:

alex.k: :thumbsup: I'll also estimate monthly storage delta and include a cost breakdown for STANDARD_IA vs Glacier.

raj.s: If no blockers I'll implement a test pipeline to a staging bucket (staging-audit-13mo) and post notes in #eng-infra.

maria.t: Thanks all — tagging security-ops to review after staging is up.
